assessments.reasoning: The FSF's 1.2 §1 at [3313,3591) defines notice-listed texts, with five-word front and 25-word back limits per passage. Section 3 at [7003,8015) expressly includes the additional media category and gives the placement sequence. The following Opaque paragraph has an independent trigger.

limitations: Whether a medium commonly has printed covers and which texts the authorized work notice requires are factual questions. Publisher identification on both covers and full-title presentation on the front are additional conditions.
reasoning: GNU FDL 1.2 §3 covers publication of more than 100 printed copies or copies on media that commonly have printed covers, provided the Document's notice requires Cover Texts. Required passages belong legibly on their designated covers. When space is insufficient, the publisher should put the first listed passages that reasonably fit on the cover and continue the rest on adjacent pages.
